tools.name: Hazardous Materials Assessor
tools.description: Assess SDS hazards under IBC Chapter 3 or NFPA 400. Export Excel, prepare HMIS room notes for Revit, and track late quantity changes for re-review.

tools.name: AI Review Toolkit
tools.description: Model-readable review workflows, scale-checked measurements, value comparison and coverage tracking. Project files remain with your AI.

tools.name: Peer Review Case File
tools.description: Manage EOR review comments, designer responses, outstanding items and verified closure.

tools.name: Fire Alarm Design Review
tools.description: Review detection, notification, power and interfaces during design QC. For shop packages, use Fire Alarm Shop Submittal Review.

tools.name: Sprinkler Design Review
tools.description: Review hazard/storage criteria, hydraulics and installation design. For shop packages, use Sprinkler Shop Submittal Review.

tools.name: Water Supply & Site Fire-Water Review
tools.description: Review flow tests, supply reliability, pumps, tanks and site-water interfaces with a supply-demand scenario worksheet.

tools.name: Life Safety & Egress Plan Review
tools.description: Trace occupant loads and exit routes from each occupied space through final discharge, with documented criteria and plan evidence.

tools.name: G-Sheet Building & Fire Code Analysis Review
tools.description: Reconcile the building code summary with the actual building, life-safety plans, specifications and fire-protection design.

tools.name: Standpipe Design Review
tools.description: Review standpipe design, hydraulic demand and pressure zones. For shop packages, use Standpipe Shop Submittal Review.

tools.name: Water Supply Workflow
tools.description: Follow the water-supply review from flow testing through preliminary sprinkler demand, pump and tank sizing.

tools.name: Flow Test Request
tools.description: Stock hydrant flow test request (suppression or fire flow). NFPA 291 procedures for 2½″ outlets only — base building number, location, hydrant selection reasons, jurisdiction ask.

tools.name: Flow Test Report
tools.description: Hydrant static/residual/pitot GPM, N1.85 supply curve, fire flow @ 20 psi. Capture results for the Sprinkler Estimator (no system demand here).

tools.name: Sprinkler System Estimator
tools.description: Prelim demand + pressure stack + duration (NFPA 13 / UFC / FM). Overlay flow-test supply curve; capture duty for Fire Pump Sizer.

tools.name: Service Line Sizer
tools.description: Estimate lead-in, backflow and riser sizes from hazard or known demand. NFPA / UFC guidance, ESFR and FM planning, illustrated arrangements and branded reports.

tools.name: Fire Pump Sizer
tools.description: Import sprinkler duty (flow, pressure, duration). NFPA 20 / UFC preliminary pump, driver, curve, and room sizing.

tools.name: Fire Tank Sizer
tools.description: Flow × duration + NFPA/UFC/FM safety, US-typical prefab steel sizes, max H/⌀ limits, concrete pad, plan diagram.

tools.name: Hydrant Loop Sizer
tools.description: Hydrant-only supply: NFPA 291 available flow, ring hydraulics with hydrant arms, velocity, single-break case, loop schematic. US or metric.

tools.name: Pump + Supply Overlay
tools.description: Adds pump net curve to city supply, overlays demand, reports margin and 150% point.

tools.name: Pressure Tank (Boyle)
tools.description: Air/water split, start/end pressure, and usable volume for pressure tanks.

tools.name: Velocity / Suction Check
tools.description: v = 0.4085Q/d². Checks pump suction velocity ≤ 15 ft/s at 150% flow.

tools.name: Fire Flow Calculator
tools.description: Required fire flow (gpm @ 20 psi) and minimum hydrants for new building design. IBC/IFC Appendix B, UFC 3-600-01, Florida FFPC / NFPA 1. Construction type, area, sprinkler reductions, UFC specials, printable report with citations.

tools.name: Branch-Line Hand Calc
tools.description: Node-by-node Q = K√P, Hazen-Williams, elevation. NFPA 13-2022.

tools.name: Junction Balancer
tools.description: Equivalent-K and 0.5 psi balance check at hydraulic junction points. Q2 = Q1·√(P2/P1).

tools.name: Hardy Cross Loop Solver
tools.description: Two-path split, ΔQ correction, convergence. NFPA 13-2022 hydraulics.

tools.name: Pipe Schedule Checker
tools.description: Sprinkler counts per pipe size for light and ordinary hazard steel. Checks when pipe schedule is allowed.

tools.name: Dry Sprinkler Water Delivery
tools.description: Dry / double-interlock delivery time · wet rejected · 10–12″ mains · PDF multi-page fixture import · HW + valves. Preliminary — not a listed method.

tools.name: Standpipe Calculator
tools.description: Class I/II/III flows, residual at top, base demand. NFPA 14-2019.

tools.name: Hanger & Stocklist Helper
tools.description: Hanger count, rod size, 5W+250 lb check, cut lengths. NFPA 13-2022 Ch. 17.

tools.name: Seismic Brace Load
tools.description: Wp, Fpw = Cp×Wp, 40/80 ft spacing. NFPA 13-2022 Ch. 18. Verify tables.

tools.name: FA Power Extenders
tools.description: NAC horn/strobe + speaker taps (25/70 V), voltage drop, booster / remote-amp warrant. NFPA 72 / UFC. Preliminary — not a listed calc.

tools.name: Occupant Load & Egress Capacity
tools.description: IBC-style occupant load factors, means of egress width capacity, minimum exits (Table 1006.3.3) and loss-of-one-exit (1005.5), travel / common path / dead-end checks — life-safety basis of design.

tools.name: Travel Distance & Nearest-Exit Checker
tools.description: Draw or import a plan with obstructions; shortest real path to the nearest exit and to the next exit if it is blocked, with areas over your limit shaded. Screening only.

tools.name: Stair Merge & Queue Screener
tools.description: Multi-floor stair egress: SFPE hydraulic model with landing merges, door queues, phased vs simultaneous, loss of one stair; hands off movement to RSET Tool. Screening only.

tools.name: Transparent RSET Tool
tools.description: Educational Required Safe Egress Time calculator — full plain-language guide plus technical chapters; Detection + Notification + Pre-movement + Movement with assumptions log and session export.

tools.name: Atrium Review Workflow
tools.description: Work through occupant load, smoke-control analysis, authority coordination and reporting.

tools.name: Atrium Smoke Exhaust
tools.description: Hub: IBC/NFPA 101, suitability, NFPA 92 algebraic, systems/SI, links to native zone & multi-cell field engines — all browser-only.

tools.name: Atrium Zone Model
tools.description: Self-contained two-zone smoke-layer engine (fill + exhaust, ASET, steady size). No CFAST install.

tools.name: Atrium Field Model
tools.description: Self-contained multi-cell column model for atrium-height filling sensitivity. Not FDS/LES — fully in-browser.

tools.name: Smoke Exhaust Scenario Lab
tools.description: Design-fire scenarios, plume/exhaust calculations, makeup air & plugholing checks, Full/Excel modes, and auditable report packages.

tools.name: ASET Screener
tools.description: Screening ASET: smoke layer descent (NFPA 92 + two-zone), hands off to RSET Tool, and exports an FDS starter file for review. Screening only.

tools.name: Atrium Screening Package
tools.description: Assemble shared atrium screening results and an AHJ kickoff handout for printing or Word.

tools.name: IBC / IFC Hazard Impacts
tools.description: H occupancy + material hazards → construction & mitigations from IBC 414/415/315 and IFC Ch. 50+, with drivers and high-cost flags (2015–2024).

tools.name: MAQ & Control Area Calculator
tools.description: Storage / use-closed / use-open vs. MAQ per control area (IFC Tables 5003.1.1(1)/(2), sprinkler and cabinet increases, Table 5003.8.3.2 story % and count) → Group H needed or not. 2021/2024, Florida Building Code 9th Edition label.

tools.name: Deflagration Vent Sizing
tools.description: NFPA 68-2023 room and process vent sizing (L×W×H, KSt/Pmax dust, Su gas, Pred) with IBC/IFC explosion-control context.

tools.name: Concrete Fire Rating Thickness
tools.description: Minimum concrete / CMU thickness for 1–4 hour fire ratings by material makeup (siliceous, carbonate, lightweight, masonry aggregates) — IBC / ACI 216.1 calculated method.

tools.name: Project File Hub
tools.description: One shared project file (fireToolshed.project.v1) across Occupant Load, atrium tools, ASET, RSET, Stair Merge and Travel Distance, with cross-app checks and per-app extract. Screening only.

tools.name: PE Fire Protection practice exam
tools.description: April 2027 CBT dress rehearsal. Form A style lock is live (15 of 85 items: Analysis + Fire Science). Handbook/code search, 8:30 clock, optional 50-minute break. Not an NCEES product.

tools.name: Study Buddy
tools.description: Class-by-class study apps — start with OCCC Human Anatomy & Physiology (BIO 1314 / BIO 1414): diagrams, flashcards, quizzes, atlas.

tools.name: Games
tools.description: Team arcade breaks in the browser — Punch-Out!!, Frogger, and Ms. Pac Maze fan remakes (touch + keyboard).

tools.name: Sprinkler Shop Submittal Review
tools.description: Compare submitted drawings and product data with the design baseline and project-selected NFPA 13, UFC and FM requirements.

tools.name: Fire Alarm Shop Submittal Review
tools.description: Compare submitted drawings and product data with the design baseline and project-selected NFPA 72, UFC and FM requirements.

tools.name: Standpipe Shop Submittal Review
tools.description: Compare submitted drawings and product data with the design baseline and project-selected NFPA 14, UFC and FM requirements.

tools.name: Fire Extinguisher Shop Submittal Review
tools.description: Compare submitted drawings and product data with the design baseline and project-selected NFPA 10, UFC and FM requirements.

tools.name: RFP & Proposal Fire Protection Review
tools.description: Build an evidence-backed preliminary scope, Word summary and RFI list from RFPs and drawings.

tools.name: Door Leakage & Corridor Smoke Screener
tools.description: Preliminary screener for closed-door leakage (orifice) and well-mixed corridor smoke concentration/visibility. Not an approval or code-compliance tool.

tools.name: Rated Wall Opening Reliability & Exposure Screener
tools.description: Preliminary screener for opening geometry, protective reliability (AND/OR fault trees), and radiant exposure near a closed protective. Not an equivalency or fire-rating tool.

tools.name: Structural Fire Member Temperature Screener
tools.description: Preliminary screener for steel temperature histories under specified fire exposure using lumped capacitance. Not structural capacity or fire-rating determination.

tools.name: Smoke/Heat Removal & Purge Screener
tools.description: Preliminary screener with three workflows: prescriptive natural vents, prescriptive mechanical exhaust, and idealized post-fire purge. Not engineered smoke control.
